name: hashlock-markets
description: Trade crypto peer-to-peer on Hashlock Markets, a non-custodial OTC desk: post or answer a request for quote, negotiate, and settle atomically through hash-time-locked escrow across Bitcoin, Ethereum, Base, Robinhood Chain, TRON and Solana. Both sides are paid or both are refunded; Hashlock never holds keys or funds.

interface.longDescription: Trade crypto peer-to-peer on Hashlock Markets, a non-custodial OTC desk: post or answer a request for quote, negotiate, and settle atomically through hash-time-locked escrow across Bitcoin, Ethereum, Base, Robinhood Chain, TRON and Solana. Both sides are paid or both are refunded; Hashlock never holds keys or funds. In chat you find assets, post requests, read quotes and negotiate; you accept as the initiator, fund and claim on the deal page with your own wallet.
interface.defaultPrompt: What can I trade on Hashlock Markets, and what is open on the board for BTC?
